notes: MoRaj Ledger now wears a mark drawn for it: a T-ACCOUNT on a navy page — a head rule with a spine dropped from its centre, entries either side, the left and right carrying the same total length. The drawing every bookkeeper recognises, and the one thing that still means something at the size of a Dock icon. It replaces the maker's shield, which said 'systems and supplies' — true of MoRaj Systems and Supplies and nothing to do with a book of account. The maker's mark stays where a maker belongs: a line at the foot of the sign-in screen. Your organisation's name is also your own now: a fresh install used to open with "MoRaj" in the sidebar and "MO" as the organisation's monogram, because the short name is seeded with the vendor's. Until you name your institution the app shows a neutral placeholder and says "Not yet named", and the line beneath names the product rather than the internal build name. This is the rule the app already followed on your documents, applied to the screen: no MoRaj name and no MoRaj mark ever stands where yours belongs. Nothing about your books changed: no migration, no posting rule, no report, no figure.
